basic.name: basic
basic.title: Basic Check
basic.description: Default modlist health check using Steam Workshop metadata, descriptions, and comments.

questions.question: Is there dependency evidence that needs review?
questions.description: Looks for dependency wording, required Workshop IDs, and load-order dependency hints. Matching is evidence-based and not a structured dependency guarantee.

questions.question: Are user comments experiencing errors with any of the mods?
questions.description: Looks for crashes, exceptions, broken behavior, and similar user-reported issues.

questions.question: Are there any reported conflicts between my mods?
questions.description: Looks for incompatibility or load-order evidence that references another selected mod.

questions.question: Do any selected mods have overlapping functionality?
questions.description: Looks for overlap, redundancy, duplicate functionality, or same-purpose wording that references another selected mod.

questions.question: Are any selected mods reported compatible with each other?
questions.description: Looks for positive compatibility, integration, patch, or works-alongside evidence that references another selected mod.

questions.question: Are users suggesting alternative mods to any that I have?
questions.description: Looks for replacement and alternative-mod suggestions in descriptions and comments.

questions.question: Are there any performance issues that people are reporting?
questions.description: Looks for lag, FPS, stutter, memory, and other performance reports.

questions.question: Is there version or build concern evidence?
questions.description: Looks for outdated, unsupported, wrong-version, or needs-update wording. No target game version is assumed.

questions.question: Which mods have negative user sentiment?
questions.description: Highlights strongly negative wording in user comments and descriptions, including abandoned, outdated, unusable, or avoid-this reports.
